name: Principal Financial Group

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Principal Financial Group logo.svg)

description: Principal is mainly a retirement-plan and asset-management company with an insurance arm, not a typical life insurer. It runs 401(k) and pension plans for businesses of all sizes (plus pension risk transfer, annuities and trust services), manages $781 billion of assets for institutional, retail and high-net-worth clients and for its own balance sheet ($1.8 trillion in assets under administration), and sells group benefits (dental, disability, life) to about 103,000 small and mid-size employers plus individual life insurance. Asset-management and plan-service fees, insurance premiums and investment spread all contribute. International pension operations in Latin America and Asia sit inside the asset-management segment.

sub.name: Life, retirement and supplemental health insurers

gics.note: Conventional label per Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-10-01), which gives only the sector and the sub-industry; GICS industry group and industry are not shown there so are left null. Mowgli classification is not set here.

employees.note: Approximately 19,700 employees: 11,600 in the US and 8,100 outside it (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Retirement and Income Solutions
businessLines.how: Plan sponsors and participants pay fees on assets and services; the company also earns a spread on guaranteed products (GICs, annuities) and premiums on pension risk transfer, which is why premiums fell $157.8M in 2025 on fewer single-premium group annuity sales.
businessLines.description: Defined contribution (401(k), 403(b)), defined benefit and nonqualified plans, stock services, pension risk transfer, guaranteed investment contracts for institutions, individual annuities (variable and RILA), mutual funds, bank products, and trust and custody.

revenue.note: Segment operating revenues; FY2024 $7,976.1M. Share is of total segment operating revenues $16,059.1M (consolidated GAAP revenues $15,625.5M)

businessLines.revenueNote: Segment operating revenues; FY2024 $7,976.1M. Share is of total segment operating revenues $16,059.1M (consolidated GAAP revenues $15,625.5M)

operatingProfit.note: Share is of total segment pre-tax operating earnings $2,257.8M, which includes Corporate $(381.2)M

businessLines.name: Principal Asset Management
businessLines.how: Management fees as a percentage of assets under management (fees rose $58.3M in 2025 on higher average AUM); in Chile fees are collected with each mandatory pension deposit instead.
businessLines.description: Global investment management (equity, fixed income, asset allocation, real estate, alternatives) for institutional, retirement, retail and high-net-worth investors, plus international pension operations in emerging markets (e.g. Chile Cuprum).

revenue.note: Segment operating revenues. 2025 operating expenses include $65.4M of impairments of a Hong Kong distribution agreement intangible and contract cost asset (10-K)

businessLines.revenueNote: Segment operating revenues. 2025 operating expenses include $65.4M of impairments of a Hong Kong distribution agreement intangible and contract cost asset (10-K)

businessLines.name: Benefits and Protection
businessLines.how: Employers and individuals pay insurance premiums; earnings depend on claims experience (2025 pre-tax earnings in Specialty Benefits rose $40.0M on better claims) and on investment income on reserves.
businessLines.description: Specialty Benefits (group dental, life, disability, supplemental health and individual disability for about 103,000 employer groups, 321,000 coverages, 3.3 million employees) and Life Insurance (business-owner solutions, individual life).
